artworks.title: The Death of Priam
artworks.description: Guérin's sack of Troy — Neoptolemus at the altar of Zeus Herkeios, the killing Pausanias pairs with his own death at Delphi.

artworks.title: Andromache Mourning Hector
artworks.description: David's Andromache — Hector's widow, taken as Neoptolemus' prize and queen of the Molossians in Epirus.

artworks.title: Orestes Slaying Neoptolemus at Delphi
artworks.description: Taillasson's altar slaughter — Orestes strikes Neoptolemus at Delphi over Hermione, closing the Returns' feud between the Aeacids and the Pelopids.
